ceiling.note: Phase 10 sparse-coverage estimate (0.833) is not used as the card default; coverage sensitivity is reported in coverage_sensitivity.csv.
ceiling.source: sqrt(coverage-aware pooled reliability at n_eval=22, coverage 0.8)

datasets.name: Randi et al. 2023 optogenetic atlas (derived trial table)
Kato et al. 2015 whole-brain calcium imaging

description: Measurement-bounded evaluation of C. elegans neural-response predictions. Scores are descriptive and must be read against the reliability ceiling.

leaderboard.caveat: Folds share animals; deltas are descriptive, not animal-level intervals.

limitations: Fold-level scores share animals and are not animal-generalisation estimates.
Virtual perturbation outputs are model-dependent and not causally validated.
The derived Randi trial table is not redistributed until its licence is confirmed.
Coverage filtering changes the responder population; 0.560 is not a bias-corrected 0.833.
The two-way bootstrap is biased on sparse real data and is not a calibrated interval.
The extrapolation gate failed; the curve beyond observed animals is not validated.
Target rankings do not replicate and are not published.
